name: Warrior’s Reflexes
body:
School divination; Level cleric 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, F (an owl’s skull), M (a drop of warrior’s blood)

EFFECT

Range 50 ft.
Area The caster and all allies within a 50-ft. burst, centered on the caster
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

Your allies become aware of what is about to happen in combat. This precognitive awareness grants each creature a +1 insight bonus to AC and Reflex saves.

Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Ares, © 2023, Bloodstone Press; Author P. C. Graves and Beth Jones
